input.command: d=$(mktemp -d /tmp/kk-review-code-XXXXXX) && git diff --cached > "$d/staged.patch" && mkdir "$d/candidate" && for f in preview.py routes.py config.py settings.py tests/test_routes.py README.md tasks.md; do mkdir -p "$d/candidate/$(dirname $f)"; git show ":$f" > "$d/candidate/$f"; done && git rev-parse HEAD && find "$d" -type f && chmod -R a-w "$d"
input.description: Materialize staged diff and index blobs outside worktree
